visual.general_description: Eight-panel composite of color photographs of one patient: preoperative frontal and side views, preoperative marking, intraoperative views, an immediate postoperative view, and two later frontal and side views.
visual.detailed_description: Panels a to c (top row) show preoperative views of the bare chest: a frontal view with one breast markedly larger, a side view with a prominent breast, and a frontal view with arms raised and concentric circles with letters A to D drawn around one nipple. Panels d, e and f (middle and lower left) are operating-room photographs with green drapes: an open incision with a gloved hand and retractors, a close-up of a ring of raw skin around the nipple-areola complex with a suture thread, and an overhead view with a stitched periareolar edge and a drain tube. Panels g and h (right) are frontal and oblique side views of the torso with the breasts of similar size and shape. Each panel carries a printed uppercase letter at its upper left; the caption uses lowercase letters. The faces are cropped in the body views. No scale bars or other text appear.

panels.general_description: Color frontal photograph of the bare chest of a person with visibly unequal breast size.
panels.detailed_description: Frontal view of the bare upper chest and shoulders, cropped above the neck, against a pale blue-gray wall with a gray band behind. The breast on the image right is much larger and lower than the breast on the image left, with fine visible superficial veins and skin stretch lines on its surface and a displaced nipple-areola complex toward its lower outer part. The breast on the image left is smaller with a darker areola near its lower portion. A printed letter label is at the upper left. No scale, ruler or other markings are visible.

panels.detailed_description: Tall panel showing a surgical field with green drapes at the top and left. A hand in a pale surgical glove with blood staining is at the top, with a finger pressing into an open, roughly oval incision. The incision opens onto a dark red, blood-filled cavity with tissue edges visible. Two metal retractors hold the wound edges at the left and right. Intact skin with scattered fine red streaks lies below. A printed letter label is at the upper left. No scale or text other than the letter is visible.
